Generalised age-period-cohort models (StMoMo)

Source: R/model-wrappers.R
stmomo.Rd

Wrapper around StMoMo (Villegas, Kaishev and Millossovich 2018): age-period-cohort ("apc"), Cairns-Blake-Dowd ("cbd", logit link), Renshaw-Haberman ("rh"), M6 ("m6", logit link) and Lee-Carter ("lc"). Models are fitted per stratum with real ages (the lower bounds of single-year intervals; models with a cohort effect need single years of age), deaths and central exposures; for the logit-link models initial exposures are approximated as central exposures plus half the deaths, and forecast death probabilities are converted to central rates (m = -log(1 - q)). Cohorts observed in fewer than clip cells get zero weight. Draws come from simulate() of the fitted model (period and cohort indexes simulated as multivariate random walks with drift and ARIMA, respectively).

Usage

stmomo(
  model = c("apc", "cbd", "rh", "m6", "lc"),
  clip = 3,
  gc_order = c(1, 1, 0)
)

Arguments

model

"apc", "cbd", "rh", "m6" or "lc".

clip

Cohorts with fewer observations get zero weight.

gc_order

ARIMA order for the cohort index.

Value

A model specification.

References

Villegas AM, Kaishev VK, Millossovich P (2018). StMoMo: an R package for stochastic mortality modeling. Journal of Statistical Software 84(3): 1-38. doi:10.18637/jss.v084.i03

Examples

if (requireNamespace("StMoMo", quietly = TRUE)) {
  x <- mt_example(deaths = "single", years = 1995:2019)
  fc <- mt_forecast(mt_fit(stmomo("cbd"), x), h = 5, n_draws = 50, seed = 1)
}
